Indicator: 700,000 of analog post-paid meters in Dhaka Division replaced with prepayment meters Achievement: 1000000 Progress/Status: Two contracts were signed on 19 June 2018 for supply of 1 million prepaid meters with related services. Installation of 87,500 single phase meters and 12,500 3 phase meters completed in 10 December 2019. All meters are functional. Data Source: BREB annual reports; Quarterly progress reports from BREB

Output: Transmission system expanded and upgraded through upgrade or construction of 132kv transmission lines and substations in Chittagong Division Indicator: 2a. 65 km of 132 kV lines upgraded in Chittagong Division between Comilla (South) and Chandpur (Baseline: 0 km in 2014) Achievement: 65 Progress/Status: Completed. 65km of 132 kV line upgraded by ACCC conductor. The line was energized on 3 May 2019. The LILO part in Kachua substation was energized in 15 January 2020. Data Source: PGCB annual reports;

Output: Consultancy support provided for Aminbazar- Maowa- Mongla 400 kV double circuit transmission line and 400/230 kV substation at Aminbazar by December 2020. Indicator: Consultancy support provided for Aminbazar- Maowa- Mongla 400 kV double circuit transmission line and 400/230 kV substation at Aminbazar by December 2020. Progress/Status: Contract was signed with GOPA- International for Design, procurement and implementation support for the construction of 174 km 400 kV Amin bazar -Maowa Mongla transmission line. The consultant team was mobilized on early 2017. The consultant provided support in procurement and bid evaluation of the 400 kV transmission line. During construction, consultant team provided their support in supervision of the line. The line is now fully energized. Data Source: PGCB annual report.
